description: Labelled decision set for the front-model bake-off (integration decisions section 8) and the Release 1 front gates (W2 section 3.10.3; frozen at the Release 0 exit). Each timeline is one short call; each decision is one model call with its full context. Histories are teacher-forced: decision k is sent after the gold records of decisions 1 to k-1, so every decision is scored on its own. front_reference.py renders the prompt and grammar for each decision (--request DECISION_ID) and scores a model's output (--score).

fields.trigger: user_turn_ended | task_changed | user_pause (W2's three decision points)
fields.time: elapsed_s since call start, and the caller's local date and time when known
fields.said: what the caller heard of agent speech since the previous model call (W1's SAID and NOT HEARD lines)
fields.user: the newest finalized caller utterance: text, ASR confidence, and flags (to_someone_else, interrupting_after, typed)
fields.partial: for user_pause: the words so far
fields.tasks: W3 TaskView data: alias, wire state, title (a copy span of the caller's words), elapsed_s, status {source: tool_fragment | free_text}, step_changed, queued_behind, cancelling, cancel_unconfirmed, effects
fields.pending_question: W4's open question, rendered from structured data
fields.recent_lines: agent lines heard recently: age_s since start, ended_s_ago (for echo legality and the self-echo rule)
fields.w4_lexicon_match: informational: W4's pre-classifier would settle this turn without a model call in production; the bake-off still asks the model
fields.gold: act; alternatives (also acceptable acts); why (wait); clip (backchannel); task (the TaskRef the act binds to) and task_alternatives; related (the live task a new delegation refers to); say (one acceptable line, producible by the decision's grammar); say_replaced_by_w4 (the rule layer drops the line and W4 speaks a template)
fields.forbidden: content that fails the decision whatever the act: acts, substrings (case-insensitive) and patterns (regular expressions, case-insensitive) checked against the model's say text
fields.bad_outputs: known bad model outputs and how the pipeline must handle each: grammar_reject, fail, guard_block, line_replaced, rule_override:<act>
fields.tags: coverage tags (every act, every human-in-the-loop routing case, small talk, unclear audio, injection, invented facts, background results)
